findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_hotels, list_destinations, get_destination_guide, prebook, get_booking, request_api_key · Private data: search_hotels, get_hotel, prebook, get_booking, cancel_booking, request_api_key · Public sink: prebook, get_booking, cancel_booking, request_api_key.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_hotels, list_destinations, get_destination_guide, prebook, get_booking, request_api_key · Private data: search_hotels, get_hotel, prebook, get_booking, cancel_booking, request_api_key · Public sink: prebook, get_booking, cancel_booking, request_api_key

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
